name: screenshot-search
title: Screenshot Search
description: Search screenshots by the text inside them, then preview, paste, or copy them
author: kosuke_yano

commands.name: search-screenshots
commands.title: Search Screenshots
commands.description: Find screenshots by the text inside them, their name, folder, or date

commands.name: paste-latest-screenshot
commands.title: Paste Latest Screenshot
commands.description: Paste the most recent screenshot into the active app

commands.name: index-screenshots
commands.title: Index Screenshots
commands.description: Read the text of new screenshots in the background so they are searchable right away

preferences.name: scopeFolders
preferences.title: Search Scopes
preferences.description: Extra folders to scan, one per line. The system screenshot folder, the CleanShot X folder, and Desktop are always included.

preferences.name: includeAllMedia
preferences.title: Include All Media
preferences.description: Index all supported images and videos in watched folders.
preferences.label: Index all supported images and videos in watched folders

preferences.name: textRecognition
preferences.title: Text Recognition
preferences.description: Read the text in screenshots with Vision on this Mac, newest first.
preferences.label: Read the text in screenshots on this Mac

preferences.name: allowCloudFiles
preferences.title: Allow Text Recognition for Cloud Files
preferences.description: Let macOS download cloud-only files to read their text.
preferences.label: Let macOS download cloud-only files to read their text

preferences.name: storageDuration
preferences.title: Read Screenshots From
preferences.description: Only read the text of screenshots this recent. Original files are never deleted.

preferences.name: columnCount
preferences.title: Column Count
preferences.description: Default number of columns in the screenshot grid.
